Soften the knees, send the hips back until the posterior chain loads, and stand by driving the hips through.
When the load leaves the hips and moves into the back, reduce the range or weight before the next rep.
cues: Set the ribs down and brace first.
Send the hips back into the load.
Finish tall through the glutes.

When posture or foot strike changes, slow the pace before continuing.
cues: Set a repeatable starting position.
Keep every stride smooth and quiet.
Finish with the same posture you started with.

setupSteps: Set up Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment with cable machine and choose a load or range you can control.

When the elbows chase the load, the extension has lost its line; shorten the range or load.
cues: Aim the elbows through one steady line.
Extend through the forearms.
Control the return into the stretch.

setupSteps: Set up Two-Arm Kettlebell Row with kettlebell and choose a load or range you can control.

cues: Set the torso before the pull.
Lead with the elbows.
Pause with the upper back engaged.
